messages:
anya_partnerships: Quick sync — launching a lightweight SI onboarding "satellite" program for APAC/EU micro-partners. Goal: 4-week ramp (training + cert) so they can sell through cloud marketplaces and support basic HW installs. Thoughts? :earth_americas:

devon_solutions: Love it. Keeps overhead low for small integrators. Are we thinking cohort-based or continuous intake?

anya_partnerships: Cohort-based to start (every 6 weeks) so we can batch trainer time and lab kit shipments. Will open signup form next Monday.

kelly_ops: Logistics note — for HW partner kits we need 10-day lead time for customs in APAC. Recommend digital-first lab (VM images + remote GPU seats) + optional local HW voucher.

chris_sales: From GTM: align one smaller joint announcement per cohort (partner highlight + marketplace listing). Marketing can do short case study blurbs. Need to lock dates 3 weeks out.

sam_lewis: Operational checklist for cohort 1 (quick):
- Create private sandbox org + 12 dev seats
- Upload AMIs / VM snapshots (ref: infra-team/ami-templates)

anya_partnerships: (continued)
- Provide a simple hw voucher flow for vendors
- Certification exam (30 min, pass/fail) + badge asset

kelly_ops: Can you drop a sample voucher flow? I can wire up procurement.

devon_solutions: Sample voucher idea (one-liner):
```
voucher: SI-SAT-APAC-001
redeem: marketplace -> claim -> email ops@redwood.com
validity: 60 days
```
Basic enough to hand to HW partners.

marketplace-bot: FYI — marketplace listing checklist updated: catalog-image, quickstart, pricing-flag, partner-link. See https://marketplace.redwood.internal/checklist

chris_sales: For announcements: suggest a 15-30s demo clip + hero quote from SI lead. Marketing will need partner logo + a brief one-paragraph win.

anya_partnerships: Action items:
- I’ll publish signup form + cohort calendar (by Mon) @devon_solutions to draft the 4-module curriculum (intro, deployment, observability, troubleshooting)
- @kelly_ops to confirm lab access and voucher flow
- @sam_lewis to provision sandbox + AMIs
- @chris_sales to coordinate marketing assets and announcement timing

sam_lewis: I can provision sandbox this week, but will need a list of participant emails. Also, recommend a lightweight terraform module to spin up the demo stack, will share in #devex.

devon_solutions: Draft curriculum outline: Week 0: orientation + marketplace onboarding. Week 1: deployment + model pinning. Week 2: monitoring + rollouts. Week 3: troubleshooting + cert exam. Each week = 2 live hours + lab exercises.

kelly_ops: Confirmed on voucher process. I’ll create the GH issue for procurement and tag @finance. Also starting customs playbook for kit shipments (optional).

anya_partnerships: Nice. One risk — marketplace approval timelines vary. @chris_sales can we flag a fallback: if listing isn't approved by announcement date, we still go ahead with partner blog + demo, and update marketplace later?

chris_sales: Yes, fallback accepted. We'll mark marketplace link as "coming soon" in assets. Keep announcements flexible.

marketplace-bot: Note: recommended minimum for listing to pass internal review — quickstart guide + security checklist completed.

anya_partnerships: Last Q: certification credential — should it be a lightweight digital badge (open) or a private Redwood-verified badge? Thoughts?

devon_solutions: Start with a public digital badge (Credly style) that links to a short verification page. If partners scale, move to Redwood-verified tier.

sam_lewis: Posted terraform module in #devex just now with README. Link: https://git.internal/redwood/si-satellite-demo (internal)

kelly_ops: I’ll open procurement GH issue and ping finance. ETA for voucher infra: 5 business days.

anya_partnerships: Great — next sync after signup goes live. Thanks team! :rocket:
